purpose: Exploratory Vietnamese corporate OCR CER/WER screening on half-page regions selected from the official PVFCCo Annual Report 2024.
reference_method: native PDF text layer clipped to selected PDF regions and sorted in visual reading order; not proofread word by word
reference_quality: The selected half-page regions were visually reviewed for prose content. References were extracted from the PDF text layer and have not been proofread against every line; text order and mixed content may affect CER/WER.
limitations: Fourteen dependent half-page regions from one born-digital annual report do not establish broad company or sector coverage.
Native PDF references are unproofread and may contain extraction-order, text-mapping, or layout discrepancies.
Regions may include headings, callouts, graphics, or other mixed content.
This is a born-digital report, not a physical-scan benchmark.
CER/WER measure text recognition only, not layout detection or table extraction.
Exploratory screening only; not eligible for primary model selection.
